items.request: W3 request 1: oiled walnut base colour, 1024x1024, 1.0 m, seamless both axes
items.prompt: A single seamless tileable orthographic material texture: dark warm oiled walnut timber, exactly 1.0 metre of surface across this square tile. Straight to gently figured grain runs horizontally from left to right, fine natural pores, restrained natural variation, few tiny knots at most 3 cm across. Palette in sRGB approximately #2a1a10 through #4a2c16, dark warm brown without orange highlights. Uniform diffuse base colour (albedo) only, delighted, completely flat orthographic full-frame swatch. Match opposite edges on BOTH axes with continuously flowing grain: left/right and top/bottom must join seamlessly when repeated in a grid. No plank gaps or board seams, no perspective, no directional light, no specular reflection, no baked shadows or ambient occlusion, no vignette, no gradients, no fixtures, no symbols, no text, no border. One 1024x1024 material tile filling the entire image.
